title: PIM Activator: upload the Intune Remediation
purpose: Builds the PIM Activator Intune Remediation (Detect + Remediate) for your tenant and uploads it to Intune -- creates it, or updates it in place when a Remediation with the same name exists -- and assigns it to the one group you name (nobody otherwise).
whenToRun: On Intune-managed devices, after the PIM Activator app registration exists (Deploy-PimActivatorBackend.ps1): PIM Manager > Operations > PIM Activator > Intune remediation shows the command with your settings. Run it again after changing the settings, or to assign the Remediation to a group.

runAs.name: Intune Administrator
runAs.why: creates / updates a Remediation (device health script) and assigns it. Global Administrator also works.

runAs.name: Delegated sign-in: DeviceManagementScripts.ReadWrite.All
runAs.scope: Microsoft Graph, for the first-party app Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools
runAs.why: the browser sign-in asks for this one delegated permission only; it acts within your Intune role. Automation: -AccessToken with the same permission.

changes.object: Detect-PimActivator.ps1 and Remediate-PimActivator.ps1 in -OutDir (default: next to the script), built from the parameters
changes.why: the pair that is uploaded, kept so you can read exactly what the devices run

changes.object: Remediation (deviceHealthScript) -Name, default 'PIM Activator settings (PROD)' / '(TEST)': the Detect + Remediate scripts, run as SYSTEM, 64-bit PowerShell, no signature check; updated in place when one with that exact name exists
changes.why: it writes the PIM Activator browser policies (force-install + tenant catalog + settings) on the devices it is assigned to, every day
changes.undo: Intune admin center > Devices > Scripts and remediations > the Remediation > Delete

changes.object: assignment to group -AssignToGroupId (user or device group); REPLACES the Remediation's assignments
changes.permission: Remediation assignment: runs on the group's devices daily at -DailyTime, or every -EveryHours hours
changes.scope: only that group -- never all users or all devices; without -AssignToGroupId nothing is assigned
changes.why: who gets the PIM Activator settings
changes.undo: Intune > the Remediation > Properties > Assignments > remove the group

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: Your tenant id: the sign-in tenant and the tenant written into the extension's catalog (required unless you upload your own pair).

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.help: Released (PROD) or Test: which extension the Remediation configures.

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.help: Application (client) id of the PIM Activator app registration of that channel (required unless you upload your own pair).

parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.help: The tenant name the users see in the extension.

parameters.name: DefaultJustification
parameters.help: The justification the extension pre-fills.

parameters.name: DefaultDurationHours
parameters.help: The activation length the extension pre-fills (1-24 hours).

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.help: Optional group-name prefix filter.

parameters.name: EntraPrefix
parameters.help: Optional prefix of the groups that carry Entra roles.

parameters.name: AzurePrefix
parameters.help: Optional prefix of the groups that carry Azure roles.

parameters.name: AutoActivateMaxGroups
parameters.help: Optional per-device cap on auto-activation (0 = off). -1 = not set.

parameters.name: BulkActivateConfirmThreshold
parameters.help: Optional: ask for confirmation above this many groups. -1 = not set.

parameters.name: Browsers
parameters.help: Which browsers the Remediation configures.

parameters.name: AdditionalTenantsJson
parameters.help: Optional: more tenants for the extension's tenant switcher (JSON array of name, tenantId, clientId).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.help: The Remediation's name in Intune (an existing one with exactly this name is updated).

parameters.name: DetectScript
parameters.help: Override: upload this detection script instead of building it (with -RemediateScript).

parameters.name: RemediateScript
parameters.help: Override: upload this remediation script instead of building it (with -DetectScript).

parameters.name: OutDir
parameters.help: Where the built pair is written.

parameters.name: AccessToken
parameters.help: Automation: a Microsoft Graph token with DeviceManagementScripts.ReadWrite.All; skips the browser sign-in.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.help: The Remediation's description in Intune.

parameters.name: AssignToGroupId
parameters.help: Object id of the group that gets the Remediation (replaces its assignments). Not given: nothing is assigned.

parameters.name: DailyTime
parameters.help: With an assignment: the daily run time (device local time).

parameters.name: EveryHours
parameters.help: With an assignment: run every N hours (1-23) instead of daily.

readsOnly: the tenant's Remediations (to find one with the same name)
the Remediation after the upload (read back: same scripts, SYSTEM, 64-bit) and its assignments
whatIf: Signs in, reads Intune, builds the pair in the temp folder (so you can read it) and prints a 'What if:' line for the Remediation it would create or update (with the scripts' checksums) and the group assignment it would make. Nothing is uploaded, assigned or written next to the script.
undo: Delete the Remediation in the Intune admin center (Devices > Scripts and remediations). Devices keep the policies it already wrote until you remove them (Deploy-PimActivatorClient.ps1 -Uninstall on a device, or a Remediation that removes them).
